titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Oath and the Plan to Take Zion (Chapter 45)
part: Chapter 45 — The Oath and the Plan to Take Zion
about: The young nobles sent with the king's son weep and take counsel: they must leave Zion, the Ark, behind. Azariah, son of Zadok the priest, makes them swear secrecy by God, the Ark, and the patriarchs, then reveals that he can take the Ark: he holds the keys of the house and will substitute a copy built by a carpenter from leftover Temple timber, paid for by a collection of ten didrachms each.

sentences.t: ፵፭ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘበከዩ ፡ ወመከሩ ፡ እለ ፡ ተፈነዉ ።
sentences.l: 45. Concerning that-they-wept and-they-took-counsel those who-were-sent.
sentences.i: Chapter 45: Concerning How Those Who Were Sent Wept and Took Counsel
sentences.n: Chapter heading; ፵፭ is the numeral 45. በእንተ 'concerning'. ዘበከዩ is ዘ- 'that which / those who' + በከዩ 'they wept' (3rd pl. perfect of በከየ); ወመከሩ 'and they took counsel' (መከረ). እለ ተፈነዉ 'who were sent' (passive ተፈነወ, from ፈነወ 'send'). The syntax is compressed; I read it as 'how the sent ones wept and counselled'.

sentences.t: ወደቂቀ ፡ መኳንንተ ፡ እስራኤልሰ ፡ እለ ፡ ተአዘዙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሖሩ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ መከሩ ፡ ኅቡረ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ ምንተ ፡ ንሬሲ ፤
sentences.l: And-sons-of princes-of Israel-indeed, who they-were-commanded that they-go with son-of king, they-counselled together while they-say: what we-do?
sentences.i: Now the sons of the princes of Israel, who had been commanded to go with the king's son, took counsel together, saying, "What shall we do?
sentences.n: ወደቂቀ is ወ- 'and' + ደቂቅ 'sons' in the construct (ደቂቀ መኳንንተ እስራኤል 'sons-of princes-of Israel'); -ሰ on እስራኤልሰ is a contrastive 'as for'. እለ ተአዘዙ 'who were commanded' (passive of አዘዘ). ከመ ይሖሩ 'that they go' (subjunctive of ሖረ). 'The king's son' is Menelik (ምኒልክ), here unnamed. እንዘ ይብሉ 'while they say' introduces direct speech. ንሬሲ 'we do/make' (1cp subjunctive of ረሰየ, whose last radical is -ይ; the -ሲ belongs to the verb and is not a question particle).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ኀደግነ ፡ ብሔረነ ፡ ወሙላደነ ፡ ወአዝማዲነ ፡ ወሰብአ ፡ ሀገርነ ።
sentences.l: For we-left our-land and-our-kindred and-our-relatives and-people-of our-city.
sentences.i: For we have left our land, our kindred, our relatives, and the people of our city.
sentences.n: እስመ 'for, because'. ኀደግነ 'we left' (ኀደገ); the nouns that follow carry -ነ 'our'. ሙላደነ is from ሙላድ 'birth, native kin' (?), glossed 'kindred'. ሰብአ is the construct of ሰብእ 'people': 'people-of our-city'. The ወ- on each noun repeats 'and' before every item, a regular Geʿez list style.

sentences.t: ወይእዜኒ ፡ ሀቡ ፡ ከመ ፡ ናቅም ፡ ኪዳነ ፡ በባሕቲትነ ፡ ዘኢያአምሩ ፡ አዝማዲነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንትፋቀር ፡ በህየ ፤
sentences.l: And-now give (= come!) that we-establish our-covenant by-our-aloneness, which not-they-know our-relatives, that we-love-one-another there;
sentences.i: And now, come, let us make a covenant among ourselves alone, one that our relatives do not know of, that we may love one another there;
sentences.n: ወይእዜኒ 'and now'. ሀቡ 'give (pl.)', used as the hortative 'come!' before a 1cp subjunctive (the house rendering, as in ሀቡኬ below). ናቅም 'we establish' (1cp subjunctive of አቀመ 'set up', the causative of ቆመ). ኪዳነ 'covenant' (accusative). በባሕቲትነ 'in/by our aloneness' (ባሕቲት 'alone' with -ነ). ዘኢያአምሩ 'which they do not know' (relative ዘ- on ኪዳን); I take the relatives as subject, but 'who do not know our relatives' is grammatically possible. ንትፋቀር is the reciprocal tä-stem of ፈቀረ 'love': 'that we love one another'.

sentences.t: ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይጔጒእ ፡ ወይጐነዲ ፡ በዝየ ፡ ወኢንፍራህ ፡ ወኢንናፍቅ ፤
sentences.l: And-none who he-disturbs (?) and-he-oppresses (?) here, and-not-we-fear and-not-we-waver (?);
sentences.i: and there is no one here to harass (?) or oppress (?) us, and let us not fear or waver (?);
sentences.n: አልቦ ዘ- 'there is none who'. ይጔጒእ and ይጐነዲ are uncertain to me without Dillmann: the first may be 'make an uproar, trouble', the second 'oppress, be harsh' (?). በዝየ 'here' (contrast በህየ 'there' above). ኢንፍራህ 'let us not fear' (jussive of ፈርሀ); ኢንናፍቅ 'let us not waver / doubt' (?), the root being doubtful. Whether the clause means 'no one will harass us here' or 'no one there can harass...' is a crux; I keep the plain reading.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ብዝየኒ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወበህየኒ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወይኩን ፡ ሥምረቱ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወሎቱ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ፡ አሜን ፨
sentences.l: For in-here-also God and-in-there-also God, and-may-be his-good-pleasure of-God, and-to-him glory until for-age-of age, Amen.
sentences.i: for God is here as well as there; may the good pleasure of God be done, and to him be glory forever and ever. Amen."
sentences.n: Source oddity: ብዝየኒ is written with ብ where I expect በ (በዝየኒ 'in here too'); flagged, read as በ-ዝየ-ኒ. -ኒ here means 'also, even'. ይኩን ሥምረቱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'may be his-good-pleasure to-God', the ለ- possessive, as in 'God's good pleasure'. The closing doxology እስከ ለዓለመ ዓለም አሜን 'until for the age of age, Amen' is the stock Geʿez 'forever and ever'. ፨ closes the princes' speech.

sentences.t: አውሥኡ ፡ አዛርያስ ፡ ወኤልሚያስ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ካህናት ፡ ባዕድሰ ፡ ኢያሐዝነነ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘጸልኡነ ፡ አዝማዲነ ፡ ወባሕቱ ፡ ነሐዝን ፡ በእንተ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ እግዝእትነ ፡ እስመ ፡ ያኀድጉነኪያሃ ፤
sentences.l: They-answered Azarias and-Elmeyas sons-of priests: other-indeed not-it-grieves-us concerning those-who they-hated-us our-relatives, but we-grieve concerning Zion our-lady, for they-cause-us-to-leave-her;
sentences.i: Azariah and Elmeyas, sons of priests, answered: "As for anything else, it does not grieve us on account of our relatives who hated us; but we grieve for Zion our lady, because we are made to leave her;
sentences.n: Azarias and Elmeyas are named here as sons of priests; Azarias will take the lead (next units: 'son of Zadok the priest'). አውሥኡ 'they answered' (አውሥአ). ደቂቀ ካህናት 'sons-of priests', construct. ባዕድሰ: ባዕድ 'other, else' with contrastive -ሰ; the verb that follows is singular, so 'as for anything else', not 'the others' (the plural ባዕዳን comes in the next speech). ኢያሐዝነነ 'does not grieve us' (3ms of the causative አሐዘነ, object -ነ; a 3pl would be ኢያሐዝኑነ). ዘጸልኡነ 'who hated us'. Source oddity: ያኀድጉነኪያሃ is written as one word, = ያኀድጉነ 'they cause us to leave' (causative of ኀደገ, with -ነ) + ኪያሃ 'her' (emphatic object pronoun); in the next unit the two are written apart. I read the 3rd plural as impersonal (?). Zion (ጽዮን) is the Ark, called 'our lady' (እግዝእትነ).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ባቲ ፡ አወፈዩነ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወተልእክነ ፡ ላቲ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዮም ፡ ወባሕቱ ፡ ነሐዝን ፡ በእንቲአሃ ፡ እስመ ፡ ያኀድጉነ ፡ ኪያሃ ፡ በእንተዝኬ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ያበክየነ ፡ በእንቲአሃ ።
sentences.l: For by-her they-offered-us to-God, and-we-were-sent (or: served) (?) to-her until today; but we-grieve for-her, for they-cause-us-to-leave her; therefore exceedingly he-makes-us-weep for-her.
sentences.i: For through her they dedicated us to God, and we have been in her service (?) up to this day; and we grieve for her because we are made to leave her; that is why we weep so bitterly over her."
sentences.n: ባቲ 'in/by her'. አወፈዩነ 'they offered/dedicated us', the causative of ወፈየ, said of the fathers who gave their sons to the service of the Ark; the same verb returns in Zachariah's speech. ተልእክነ 'we were sent' (tä-stem of ልእከ 'send'); but ተላእከ 'serve, minister' would be spelled the same, and 'we have served her' suits sons of the Ark's priests (?). እስከ ዮም 'until today'. በእንተዝኬ 'therefore' (በእንተዝ + particle -ኬ). ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly'. ያበክየነ 'it makes us weep' (causative of በከየ), and so the cause of the weeping named in the chapter heading.

sentences.t: ወአውሥኡ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ባዕዳን ፡ ወይቤልዎሙ ፡ በአማን ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ እግዝእትነ ፡ ተስፋነ ፡ ወምክሕ ፡ ነ ፡ ወልህቅነ ፡ በብፅዓቲሃ ፡ ወበአይቴ ፡ ንክል ፡ ኀዲጎታ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ እግዝእትነ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-answered those others and-they-said-to-them: in-truth this she our-lady, our-hope and-our-boast (?) and-our-greatness by-her-promises, and-where we-can leaving-her, Zion our-lady;
sentences.i: Then those others answered them: "Truly she is our lady, our hope, our boast, and our greatness through her promises. How could we abandon Zion our lady?
sentences.n: በአማን 'in truth'. ዛቲ ይእቲ 'this one, she' (an emphatic copula). Source oddity: ምክሕ ፡ ነ is split by a wordspace; I read ምክሕነ 'our boast' (ምክሕ 'boast, pride' + -ነ). ልህቅነ 'our greatness' (ልህቅ, from ልህቀ 'be great'; the sense 'growth/greatness' is uncertain (?)). ብፅዓት is 'promise, vow'; -ሃ 'her'. ወበአይቴ ንክል ኀዲጎታ 'and where/how can we leave her' with the infinitive ኀዲጎት + object -ታ, then ለጽዮን naming the object (the same anticipating ለ- construction as in ch. 44). 'Those others' are the rest of the king's-son's company who had not spoken.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ተውህብነ ፡ ወምንተ ፡ ንሬሲ ፤
sentences.l: for to-her we-were-given; and-what we-do?
sentences.i: for to her we were given; and what are we to do?
sentences.n: ተውህብነ 'we were given' (passive of ወሀበ 'give'). The thought: they belong to Zion by dedication.

sentences.t: ሶበ ፡ አበይነ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ይቀትለነ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወኢንክል ፡ ተዐድዎ ፡ እምቃለ ፡ አበዊነ ፡ ወእምትእዛዘ ፡ ንጉሥ ፤
sentences.l: When we-refuse his-command, he-kills-us king, and-not we-can to-transgress the-word-of our-fathers and-the-command-of king;
sentences.i: If we refuse his command, the king will put us to death, and we cannot transgress the word of our fathers and the command of the king;
sentences.n: ሶበ here 'if, when'. አበይነ 'we refused' (አበየ). ተዐድዎ is the verbal noun of ተዐደወ 'pass over, transgress' (the final -ዎ is the noun's ending, not 'him'), 'to transgress'. ቃለ and ትእዛዘ are constructs: 'word-of fathers', 'command-of king'. The 'king' is Solomon, who gave the order that they go with Menelik; ትእዛዞ 'his command' anticipates ንጉሥ (compare ch. 44) (?).

sentences.t: ወምንተ ፡ ንገብር ፡ በእንተ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ እግዝእትነ ፨
sentences.l: And-what we-do for Zion our-lady?
sentences.i: But what are we to do about Zion our lady?"
sentences.n: ንገብር 'we do' (ገብረ). ፨ closes the exchange. The refrain 'what shall we do' (ምንተ ንሬሲ, ምንተ ንገብር) frames the whole scene.

sentences.t: ወአውሥአ ፡ አዛርያስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሳዶቅ ፡ ካህን ፡ ወይቤ ፡ አነ ፡ እመክረክሙ ፡ ዘንገብር ፡ ወሀቡኒ ፡ ኪዳነ ፡ እስከ ፡ ፀአተ ፡ ነፍስክሙ ፡ ወመሐሉ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትንግሩ ፡ እመሂ ፡ ሞትነ ፡ ወእመሂ ፡ ሐየውነ ፡ ወእመሂ ፡ ተእኅዝነ ፡ ወእመሂ ፡ ወፃእነ ።
sentences.l: And-answered Azarias son-of Zadok priest and-said: I I-counsel-you what we-do; and-give-me a-covenant until departure-of your-soul, and-swear to-me that not-you-tell, whether we-die and-whether we-live, and-whether we-are-seized and-whether we-go-out.
sentences.i: Then Azariah, the son of Zadok the priest, answered and said: "I will advise you what we are to do. But give me a covenant, until your souls depart, and swear to me that you will tell no one, whether we die or live, whether we are seized or go free."
sentences.n: ወልደ ሳዶቅ ካህን: Zadok the priest, as in 1 Kings 1:39 and 2:35, where he serves Solomon. እመክረክሙ 'I will counsel you' (መከረ with object -ክሙ). ወሀቡኒ 'and give me' (-ኒ object 'me', ሊተ below is 'to me'). ፀአተ ነፍስክሙ 'the going-out of your souls', i.e. death, in the construct. መሐሉ 'swear (pl.)' (መሐለ). ከመ ኢትንግሩ 'that you not tell'. እመሂ ... ወእመሂ 'whether ... or' (እመ 'if' + ሂ), in four members. ተእኅዝነ 'we are seized'; ወፃእነ 'we go out' (ወፅአ; the ፃ is Bezold's spelling).

sentences.t: ወመሐሉ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ በስመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወበጽዮን ፡ ሰማያዊት ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወበዘአሰፈዎ ፡ ለአብርሃም ፡ ወበንጽሑ ፡ ወበኂሩቱ ፡ ለይስሐቅ ፡ ወበዘአስተባዝኆ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ ወአውረሶ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ነኪረ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወለዘርኡ ፡ እምድኅሬሁ ።
sentences.l: And-they-swore to-him by-name-of God, God-of Israel, and-by-Zion heavenly, ark-of his-law of-God, and-by-him-who he-gave-hope (?) to-Abraham, and-by-his-purity and-by-his-goodness of-Isaac, and-by-him-who he-multiplied-him to-Jacob and-he-made-inherit-him a-land foreign to-him and-to-his-seed after-him.
sentences.i: And they swore to him by the name of God, the God of Israel; by heavenly Zion, the Ark of the law of God; by him who gave Abraham hope (?), by the purity and goodness of Isaac, and by him who multiplied Jacob and gave him as an inheritance a land foreign to him and to his seed after him.
sentences.n: መሐሉ ሎቱ 'they swore to him'. በስመ 'by the name of' (construct). ጽዮን ሰማያዊት 'heavenly Zion' echoes Hebrews 12:22 ('the heavenly Jerusalem'); here Zion is the Ark of the Covenant (ታቦተ ሕጉ 'ark-of his law', ሕጉ = ሕግ + -ሁ). The oath names the three patriarchs. በዘአሰፈዎ: በ- 'by' + ዘ 'him who' + አሰፈዎ, perhaps a causative from the root of ተስፋ 'hope' (?) with object -ዎ; the exact meaning is uncertain. ንጽሑ 'his purity' and ኂሩቱ 'his goodness', then ለይስሐቅ gives the owner (Isaac). አስተባዝኆ (causative of ብዝኀ 'be many'): 'multiplied him'; አውረሶ 'made him inherit' (አውረሰ). ምድረ ነኪረ 'a foreign land': Genesis 28:4, 'the land of your sojournings' (Canaan).

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ ሶበ ፡ መሐሉ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ አውሥኦሙ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሀቡኬ ፡ ንንሥኣ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ እግዝእትነ ፡ ወዘከመሂ ፡ ንነሥኣ ፡ አየድዐክሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-this when they-swore to-him, he-answered-them and-said-to-them: give (= come)-then we-take-her, Zion our-lady, and-however we-take-her I-make-known to-you;
sentences.i: And when they had sworn this to him, he answered them and said: "Come, then, let us take Zion our lady; and however we take her, I shall make known to you.
sentences.n: ሶበ መሐሉ 'when they swore'. አውሥኦሙ 'he answered them'. ሀቡኬ 'come, then' (hortative ሀቡ + -ኬ, as in ch. 2-8). ንንሥኣ 'we take her' (ነሥአ, subjunctive, object -ኣ). ዘከመሂ 'in whatever manner' (ዘከመ 'as' + ሂ). አየድዐክሙ 'I will make known to you': 1cs imperfect of አይድዐ 'make known' (as in ch. 31-32) + -ክሙ 'you'. There is no negative in the form (Geʿez negates with ኢ-; the አ- is the 1cs prefix), so I do not read 'I will not tell you'; he sets the plan out in his speech below.

sentences.t: ወግበሩ ፡ ምክርየ ፡ ለእመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ፈቀደ ፡ ንክል ፡ ነሢኦታ ፡ ለእግዝእትነ ፡ ምስሌነ ፡ ወለእመኒ ፡ አእመሩነ ፡ ወቀተሉነ ፡ ኢያሐዝነነ ፡ እስመ ፡ በእንተ ፡ እግዝእትነ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ንመውት ።
sentences.l: And-do my-counsel: if God he-willed, we-can taking-her, our-lady, with-us; and-if they-find-us and-they-kill-us, not-it-grieves-us, for on-behalf-of our-lady Zion we-die.
sentences.i: Do as I advise: if God wills, we shall be able to take our lady with us; and if they find us out and kill us, it will not grieve us, for we die for our lady Zion."
sentences.n: ግበሩ 'do (pl.)'. ምክርየ 'my counsel'. ለእመ 'if'; ለእመኒ 'and even if' (with -ኒ). ንክል ነሢኦታ 'we can take her' (ክህለ with the infinitive ነሢኦት + -ታ, as with ኀዲጎታ above). አእመሩነ 'they find us out/recognize us'. ቀተሉነ 'they kill us' (perfect used as a conditional, like አእመሩነ). ንመውት 'we die' (ሞተ).

sentences.t: ወተንሥኡ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ወሰዐምዎ ፡ ርእሶ ፡ ወገጾ ፡ ወዐይኖ ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ንገብር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘአምከርከነ ፡ ንመውትሂ ፡ ወነሐዩሂ ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ በእንተ ፡ እግዝእትነ ፡ ጽዮን ፤
sentences.l: And-they-arose all-of-them and-they-kissed-him his-head and-his-face and-his-eyes, and-they-said-to-him: we-do all what you-counselled-us; we-die-also and-we-live-also with-you for our-lady Zion;
sentences.i: Then they all rose and kissed him on his head, his face, and his eyes, and said to him: "We will do all that you have advised us; we will die with you and live with you, for our lady Zion;
sentences.n: ወተንሥኡ 'and they arose' (ተንሥአ). ሰዐምዎ ርእሶ ወገጾ ወዐይኖ: ሰዐመ 'kiss', with a double accusative (him, then the parts kissed): 'head-his, face-his, eyes-his'. ዘአምከርከነ 'what you counselled us' (ዘ- + 2ms perfect አምከርከ of አምከረ, the causative of መከረ, + -ነ 'us'). ንመውትሂ ወነሐዩሂ: the paired -ሂ gives 'both die and live'. ምስሌከ 'with you'.

sentences.t: እመኒ ፡ ሞትነ ፡ ኢያሐዝነነ ፡ ወለእመ ፡ ሐየውነ ፡ ዘፈቀደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ይከውን ።
sentences.l: Even-if we-die not-it-grieves-us, and-if we-live what he-willed God it-will-be.
sentences.i: if we die, it does not grieve us, and if we live, what God has willed will come to pass."
sentences.n: እመኒ ... ወለእመ 'even if ... and if', balancing the two outcomes. ዘፈቀደ እግዚኣብሔር ይከውን 'what God willed will be' (ከነ 'be, become'). Compare the 'whether we die or live' of the oath above.

sentences.t: ወይቤ ፡ ፩ ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዮአስ ፡ ዘስሙ ፡ ዘካርያስ ፡ አንሰ ፡ ስእንኩ ፡ ነቢረ ፡ እምብዝኀ ፡ ፍሥሓ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ልብየ ፤
sentences.l: And-said one from-them, son-of Joas, whose-name Zachariah: I-indeed I-am-unable to-sit from-abundance-of joy which-in my-heart;
sentences.i: One of them, the son of Joas, whose name was Zachariah, said: "As for me, I cannot sit still for the great joy in my heart.
sentences.n: ፩ is the numeral 1: 'one of them' (እምኔሆሙ 'from them'). ወልደ ዮአስ ዘስሙ ዘካርያስ 'son-of Joas, whose-name Zachariah'. አንሰ 'I, for my part' (-ሰ). ስእንኩ 'I am unable' (ስእነ 'be unable'); ነቢረ 'to sit/dwell' (infinitive). እምብዝኀ ፍሥሓ 'from the abundance-of joy' (ብዝኀ is the construct of the noun 'abundance'). ዘውስተ ልብየ 'which is in my heart'. The joy is at the prospect of the Ark.

sentences.t: ንግረኒኬ ፡ አንተሰ ፡ ትክል ፡ ነሢኦታ ፡ በአማን ፡ ወኢኮነ ፡ ሐሰት ፡ እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ ታንሶሱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ህየንተ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ወመራኁትኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ጊዜ ፤
sentences.l: Tell-me-then: you-indeed you-can taking-her in-truth and-not-it-is lie, for you you-walk-about (?) in house-of God in-place-of your-father, and-keys-also in-your-hand all time;
sentences.i: Tell me then: you, for your part, are truly able to take her, and it is no falsehood; for you go about the house of God in your father's place, and the keys are in your hand at all times.
sentences.n: ንግረኒኬ 'tell me then' (imperative + -ኒ me + -ኬ). አንተሰ 'you, for your part'. ትክል 'you can'. ወኢኮነ ሐሰት 'and it is not falsehood' (ኮነ 'be'). ታንሶሱ 'you walk about / minister' (2ms imperfect of the quadriliteral አንሶሰወ; in the published ch. 13-20 the same letters are 3fs, of the Ark). Whether the clause is a question or an assertion is open; the following እስመ favours assertion. ህየንተ አቡከ 'in place of your father' (ህየንተ is a construct preposition). መራኁት 'keys' (plural of መርኆ), here with -ኒ 'and, indeed'. ኵሎ ጊዜ 'every time'. The statement shows Azarias holds the keys of the house in his father's place.

sentences.t: ወዘእንበለ ፡ ይንሥኡ ፡ መራኁተ ፡ እምእዴከ ፡ ጠይቅ ፡ በዘ ፡ ንመክር ፡ ወመሳክዋተኒ ፡ ኅቡኣተ ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ አንተ ፡ ታአምር ፤
sentences.l: And-before they-take keys from-your-hand, examine by-what we-counsel; and-the-windows (?) also hidden which he-made king Solomon you you-know;
sentences.i: Before they take the keys from your hand, consider carefully how we should proceed; and the hidden windows (?) that King Solomon made, you know them;
sentences.n: ዘእንበለ ይንሥኡ 'before they take' (ዘእንበለ + subjunctive 'without that / before'). ጠይቅ 'examine, consider carefully' (imperative). በዘ ንመክር 'by what we counsel'. መሳክዋት is the plural of መስኮት 'window'; ኅቡኣተ 'hidden' (fem. plural). The exact structure referred to (hidden windows or recesses of Solomon's house) is uncertain (?). ንጉሥ ሰሎሞን 'King Solomon'.

sentences.t: ወካህናትኒ ፡ አልቦሙ ፡ ዘይበውኡ ፡ ህየ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ምዕረ ፡ በበ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሡዕ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቅድስተ ፡ ቅዱሳን ፡ በእንተ ፡ ርእሱ ፡ ወበእንተ ፡ ሕዝብ ፤
sentences.l: And-priests-also none-for-them who they-enter there except your-father once each year, that he-sacrifice in holy-of holies for himself and-for people;
sentences.i: And none of the priests enters there except your father, once each year, to offer sacrifice in the Holy of Holies for himself and for the people.
sentences.n: ካህናትኒ 'and the priests' (-ኒ 'also, and'). አልቦሙ ዘይበውኡ 'there is none for them who enters' (ቦአ 'enter'). ዘእንበለ here is 'except'. ምዕረ በበ ዓመት 'once every year'; በበ is the distributive 'each'. ይሡዕ 'that he sacrifice' (ሦዐ). ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'holy-of holies' (construct); the high priest's annual entry on the Day of Atonement, Leviticus 16 and Hebrews 9:7. ሕዝብ 'people'.

sentences.t: ፍቅድ ፡ ወኀሊወኢትኑም ፡ በእንተዝ ፡ ግብር ፡ ከመ ፡ ትፍቅድ ፡ ነሢኦታ ፡ ወንሖር ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ በከመ ፡ አወፈዩነ ፡ ወትኩን ፡ ለነ ፡ ፍሥሓ ፡ ወለአበዊነ ፡ ሐዘን ፡ በምጽአተ ፡ ዚአሃ ፡ ምስሌነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ።
sentences.l: Will! (?) and-think and-not-sleep concerning-this deed, that you-will taking-her, and-we-go with-her as they-offered-us; and-may-it-be to-us joy and-to-our-fathers sorrow at-coming hers with-us to land-of Ethiopia.
sentences.i: Resolve, and think, and do not sleep over this deed: that you wish to take her and that we go with her, as they dedicated us; and may there be joy for us, and sorrow for our fathers, at her coming with us to the land of Ethiopia."
sentences.n: Source oddity: ወኀሊወኢትኑም is written as one word: ወ- 'and' + ኀሊ 'think!' (2ms imperative of ኀለየ) + ወ- 'and' + ኢትኑም 'do not sleep' (2ms jussive of ኖመ). ፍቅድ I read as the 2ms imperative of ፈቀደ, 'wish! resolve!' (?), not the noun ፍቅድ 'will'. በእንተዝ ግብር 'concerning this deed'. ትፍቅድ ነሢኦታ 'you wish to take her'. ንሖር 'we go'. በከመ አወፈዩነ 'as they offered us', echoing unit 7. ሐዘን 'sorrow'. ምጽአተ ዚአሃ 'her coming' (ምጽአት, construct-like, with ዚአሃ 'hers'). ሀገረ ኢትዮጵያ 'city/land of Ethiopia'. ወትኩን 'and may it be' (3fs jussive) continues the ከመ clause.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ አዛርያስ ፡ ግበሩ ፡ ዘአነ ፡ እቤለክሙ ፡ ወንረክብ ፡ ሀቡኒ ፡ በበ ፡ ፲ ፡ ዲድረክም ፡ ወእሁቦ ፡ ለፀራቢ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያፍጥን ፡ ሊተ ፡ ገቢረ ፡ አልዋሐ ፡ ሠናያነ ፡ ወያስተጣግዖን ፡ ሊተ ፡ ፍጡነ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ፍቅረ ፡ ብሩር ፡ በቆማ ፡ ወግድማ ፡ ወኑኃ ፡ ወስፍራ ፡ ለእግዝእትየ ፤
sentences.l: And-then he-said-to-them Azarias: do what I I-say-to-you and-we-find; give-me each ten didrachms, and-I-give to-the-carpenter that he-hurry for-me making boards good, and-he-fit-them for-me quickly for love-of silver, to-her-height and-her-breadth (?) and-her-length and-her-measure, for my-lady;
sentences.i: Then Azariah said to them: "Do what I tell you, and we shall find it. Give me ten didrachms each, and I will give them to the carpenter so that he hurries to make me good boards and fits them together for me quickly, for the love of silver, to the height, breadth (?), length, and measure of my lady;
sentences.n: ወእምዝ 'and then'. ግበሩ 'do'. ንረክብ 'we find / obtain' (ረከበ). በበ ፲ 'ten each' (distributive). Source oddity: ዲድረክም here and ዲድርክም twice near the end; the word is the Greek didrachm (two drachmas), a coin; I keep both spellings. The carpenter is ፀራቢ here and ጸራቢ below (ፀ/ጸ variation). ያፍጥን ... ገቢረ 'that he hasten to make' (አፍጠነ). አልዋሐ 'boards' (plural አልዋሕ; the singular is uncertain (?), see the glossary). ያስተጣግዖን 'he fits them' (አስተጣግዐ 'join together'; -ን 3fp 'them'). ፍቅረ ብሩር 'love-of silver' (construct), i.e. the carpenter's love of money, which Azariah appeals to. ቆማ ወግድማ ወኑኃ ወስፍራ 'her height, her breadth(?), her length, her measure': the dimensions of the Ark; ግድማ is uncertain (?). ለእግዝእትየ 'for my lady': Zion again.

sentences.t: ወእሁቦ ፡ ሰፊርየ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ወእብሎ ፡ ረሲ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ምስማከ ፡ ከመ ፡ እግበር ፡ አርማሰ ፤
sentences.l: And-I-give-him my-measure for-her, and-I-say-to-him: make for-me nails that I-make a-raft (?);
sentences.i: I will give him my measurements for her and say to him, 'Make me nails, so that I may make a raft (?),
sentences.n: ወእሁቦ 'and I give him' (ወሀበ). ሰፊርየ 'my measure' (?) from ሰፈረ 'measure'; I take it as the dimensions given in the previous unit. እብሎ 'I say to him'. ረሲ 'make!' (imperative of ረሰየ). ምስማከ 'nails' (accusative; ምስማር is the usual form, so ምስማክ is a variant). አርማሰ: አርማስ is unknown to me (?); I take it with ረመስ 'raft' (?) below, because of the sea context; the accusative ending is -ሰ, so the base is አርማስ. The cover is that the boards are for a traveller's gear (?).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ነሐውር ፡ ዲበ ፡ ባሕር ፤
sentences.l: for we-go upon sea;
sentences.i: for we are to go over the sea;
sentences.n: ነሐውር 'we go' (ሖረ). ዲበ 'upon'. ባሕር 'sea'. The pretence of a voyage is the cover story for the carpenter.

sentences.t: እመቦ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ተጐድአት ፡ ሐመር ፡ ከመ ፡ እዕርግ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ረመስ ፡ ወንድኀን ፡ እምባሕር ፤
sentences.l: if-there-is, if it-was-wrecked (?) ship that I-climb to raft (?) and-we-be-saved from-sea;
sentences.i: in case the ship is wrecked, so that I climb onto a raft (?) and we be saved from the sea.'
sentences.n: እመቦ ለእመ 'if there be, if' (a doubled conditional). ተጐድአት 'it was wrecked / damaged' (ተጐድአ, uncertain (?)), fem. because ሐመር 'ship' is fem. እዕርግ 'I climb' (ዐርገ). ረመስ is uncertain to me (?), perhaps a float. ንድኀን 'we be saved' (ድኅነ).

sentences.t: ወአነ ፡ እወስዳ ፡ በበ ፡ ፭ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ አስተጣግዖ ፡ ወበህየ ፡ ኣስተላጽቆን ፡ ለእሙንቱ ፡ ዕፀው ፡ ወኣነብሮን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምንባሪሃ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ወኣለብሶን ፡ አልባሲሃ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ወእነሥኣ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ወእከሪ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ወኣነብራ ፡ ህየ ፡ እስከ ፡ ነሐውር ፡ ወንነሥኣ ፡ ምስሌነ ፤
sentences.l: And-I I-take-her (them?) each five without joining-her, and-there I-have-them-joined (?) those woods, and-I-set-them in her-place-of-setting, of-Zion, and-I-clothe-them her-garments, of-Zion, and-I-take her, Zion, and-I-dig earth and-I-set-her there until we-go and-we-take-her with-us;
sentences.i: I will take them five at a time (?) unjoined, and there I will have those timbers joined (?) and set them in the place of Zion, and clothe them in the garments of Zion; then I will take Zion, dig into the ground, and set her there until we go off and take her with us.
sentences.n: እወስዳ 'I will take her/them' (ወሰደ); ዘእንበለ አስተጣግዖ 'without joining' (infinitive with suffix): the five boards are carried unjoined (?). Source oddity: ኣስተላጽቆን, ኣነብሮን, ኣለብሶን, ኣነብራ are written with ኣ (4th order) rather than አ; I read the same 1st sg. imperfect. ኣስተላጽቆን 'I make them cling / join' (the root ላጸቀ, 'adhere') with -ን 'them' (?). ዕፀው 'trees, timber' (plural of ዕፅ). ውስተ ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'into her place of sitting, of Zion': the throne-seat of the Ark in the Holy of Holies. ኣለብሶን 'I clothe them' with አልባሲሃ 'her garments' (the coverings of the Ark). እነሥኣ 'I take her'; እከሪ 'I dig' (ከረየ); ኣነብራ 'I set her down'. The plan: a replica Ark stands in the Ark's place; the real one is buried until the journey.

sentences.t: ወለእግዚእየሰ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ኢይነግሮ ፡ እስከ ፡ ነሐውር ፡ ርሑቀ ።
sentences.l: And-as-for-my-lord, the-king, not let-one-tell-him until we-go far.
sentences.i: As for my lord the king, let no one tell him until we have gone far away."
sentences.n: ወለእግዚእየሰ ንጉሥ 'and as for my lord, the king', ለ- anticipating the object and ሰ contrastive. ኢይነግሮ 'let one not tell him' (3ms jussive active of ነገረ + -ሁ 'him'; the subject is indefinite, and the suffix resumes ለእግዚእየ, the king). እስከ ነሐውር 'until we go'. ርሑቀ 'far' (adverbial accusative).

sentences.t: ወወሀብዎ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ በበ ፡ ፲ ፡ ዲድርክም ፡ ወገብሩ ፡ ፻ወ፵ ፡ ዲድርክም ፡ ወነሥኦ ፡ ወወሀቦ ፡ ለጸራቢ ፡ ወአሠነየ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ በአሐቲ ፡ ጊዜ ፡ እምነ ፡ ተረፋተ ፡ ዕፀው ፡ ዘቤተ ፡ መቅደስ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-gave-him all-of-them each ten didrachms, and-they-made 140 didrachms, and-he-took-it and-he-gave-it to-the-carpenter, and-he-did-well for-him at-one time from remnants-of woods which-of house-of sanctuary;
sentences.i: Then they all gave him ten didrachms each, and they made one hundred and forty didrachms. He took them and gave them to the carpenter, who worked well for him at one time (?), out of the timber left over from the Temple;
sentences.n: ወወሀብዎ 'and they gave him' (ወሀበ). Source oddity: ፻ወ፵ is the numeral 100 + 40; per the project rule it is read 'spoken ምእት ወአርብዓ (məʾət wä-ʾärbəʿa) one hundred and forty'. At ten each, this means fourteen contributors (arithmetic, not stated). ዲድርክም spelled thus here (ዲድረክም above). ጸራቢ 'carpenter' (here ጸ, earlier ፀ). አሠነየ ሎቱ 'did well for him' (አሠነየ, causative of ሠነየ 'be good'). በአሐቲ ጊዜ 'at one time' (perhaps 'at once' (?)). ተረፋተ ዕፀው 'remnants of timber'. ቤተ መቅደስ 'house of the sanctuary', the Temple. Solomon's leftover timber is used to counterfeit his Ark.

sentences.t: ወተፈሥሐ ፡ ወአርአዮሙ ፡ ለአኀዊሁ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-he-rejoiced and-he-showed-them to-his-brothers.
sentences.i: and he rejoiced, and showed them to his brothers.
sentences.n: ወተፈሥሐ 'and he rejoiced' (ተፈሥሐ). አርአዮሙ 'he showed them' (አርአየ, causative of ርእየ 'see'), -ሙ masc. plural, taking the boards as the object. ለአኀዊሁ 'to his brothers', meaning his companions. The run ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ is Bezold's closing ornament for the section; kept on the last unit.
